delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the in-chain parent scene — preserve its held set and existing composition. The SECOND image is the crowd exemplar — use only its anonymous crowd proportion and face tier. The THIRD image is the `lettering-marker-italic` environment reference — preserve its authored place facts.

The same lamp-lit warehouse: shoulder-high pallets of sealed brown cartons receding toward the shut roller door, the film drawn hard round the lower courses and cut back clear of the whole unwrapped top row, the crew of packers at the far pallet, the tally card carrying '26,000' against the front pallet. Only this changes: the front carton on that unwrapped top row now stands with its flaps folded open, one red clay brick lying inside it on crumpled paper and filling the box exactly; everything else exactly as established.
